_meta.ptally/summary: Works out a price for a project from the details you give it. Nothing is saved unless you ask for it to be, so it's safe to try as often as you like.
_meta.swallow/summary: Works out a price for a project from the details you give it. Nothing is saved unless you ask for it to be, so it's safe to try as often as you like.

description: Price a quote against a stored project: a dry run by default, saved only with `save: true`. Takes `project_reference`, an optional `version_reference` (defaults to the latest live version; there is no fallback to drafts, so pass `version_reference` to price one — it must belong to the project and not be archived, else a tool error), and an `input` payload that matches the project's input schema. Runs the pricing engine and returns the quote envelope — `output`, `result`, `valid`, `status`, `error`, the engine's `errors` log, `exec_time_ms`, `dry_run: true`, a null `quote_reference`, and `documents` (the indexed project documents for the version that priced it, `[{ document_reference, title, pages }]`, to answer questions about cover with search_docs) — WITHOUT persisting a quotes row. With `save: true` the quote is stored like a POST /quotes, under the signed-in user (an engine error is stored as an error quote), and the envelope carries `dry_run: false`, its `quote_reference`, `created_at` and `quote_url`; it then shows in get_quotes and the dashboard and can be amended with amend_quote. Only save when the user asks for the quote to be kept, not to try inputs. Saving is refused in read-only mode. Call get_project first to inspect `input.format` and build a valid input.

input.description: Flat quote input object matching the project's input.format schema. Use get_project to discover the required keys.

project_reference.description: UUID of the project to price against.

save.description: Optional, default false (dry run, nothing stored). true stores the quote under the signed-in user and returns its quote_reference. Only when the user asks for the quote to be kept.

source.description: Optional engine `source` label passed through to the model. Defaults to "mcp".

version_reference.description: Optional. Specific non-archived version UUID of this project; defaults to the latest live version (no fallback to drafts).

name: run_quote
title: Try a quote
